findings.title: The optimized paginator cannot paginate audit-log datetimes
findings.body: This paginator is used with `order_by="-datetime"`, but `AuditLogEntry.datetime` is a `datetime`, and `math.floor(value)` raises `TypeError`. On the first optimized request with any results, `build_cursor` calls this method and the endpoint returns a 500. The cursor conversion is also incompatible: `value_from_cursor` returns the raw integer cursor value rather than converting it back to a datetime, so subsequent-page filtering would fail even if key generation were fixed.

findings.title: Negative offsets still fail on Django querysets
findings.body: Django does not support negative `QuerySet` slice indexes; evaluating `queryset[-N:stop]` raises `ValueError`. Consequently, an optimized request with a cursor containing a negative offset reaches this branch and returns a 500 instead of providing the advertised negative-offset pagination. `Cursor` accepts signed offsets, so such a cursor can be supplied.
